title: IndiaMART and Zoho CRM Integration
seoTitle: IndiaMART Zoho CRM Integration: Leads Into CRM Instantly
seoDescription: Pull IndiaMART buy leads and enquiries into Zoho CRM automatically, assign them to sales and follow up faster. How it works, setup and common issues.
summary: An IndiaMART–Zoho CRM integration pulls every IndiaMART enquiry and purchased buy lead into Zoho CRM automatically, assigns it to a salesperson and starts follow-up, instead of staff copying leads from the IndiaMART seller panel. Speed matters: buyers often contact several suppliers at once.

dataPoints.label: IndiaMART side
dataPoints.value: Lead Manager CRM integration (pull API with a CRM key), available to paid sellers

dataPoints.label: Zoho side
dataPoints.value: Zoho CRM REST API or a marketplace extension

dataPoints.label: What syncs
dataPoints.value: Buyer name, company, phone, email, city, product enquired, message, lead source

dataPoints.label: Duplicate handling
dataPoints.value: Match on phone number to avoid repeat leads from the same buyer

dataPoints.label: Typical effort
dataPoints.value: Days with an extension; 1–2 weeks custom with assignment rules and WhatsApp follow-up

body:
## How it works

1. The integration calls IndiaMART's lead API every few minutes with your CRM key.
2. New enquiries are created as Zoho leads, tagged with source and product.
3. Assignment rules route leads by product, city or round-robin.
4. An instant WhatsApp or email acknowledgement can go to the buyer.

## Getting more from IndiaMART leads

Measure time to first response and conversion by product category; many sellers find a small number of categories produce most orders. See [automating sales follow-up](/blog/automating-sales-follow-up-with-ai-without-sounding-like-a-robot).

faqs.q: Does this work with free IndiaMART listings?
faqs.a: The lead API is generally tied to paid seller plans; check your plan with IndiaMART.

faqs.q: Can the same set-up work for TradeIndia or Justdial?
faqs.a: Similar integrations are possible where those platforms provide lead exports or APIs; each needs its own connector.
